topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: The package sat by the door, wrapped in paper I hadn’t seen before, marked with scribbles that weren’t my own. My hand paused mid-air before it, as if the air had thickened. The shape inside was a guess, a box of secrets not mine. I traced the unfamiliar name, a ghost of someone else’s story lingering on my threshold. The door felt heavier, the silence in the room deeper. I stepped back, letting the package hold space, considering what it meant that it had found me, meant for someone who no longer lived here, a mix of messages crossed in the quiet of my home.
